name: YJ Meta3 3x3 (Magnetic)
description: The YJ Meta3 3x3 (Magnetic) is the standard version of the Meta. It comes equipped with a piece-to-piece magnetic system for consistent turns at a great value. It keeps the same upgraded base mechanism as the higher-end models, like center skirts, edge cut-outs, and anti-twist corner caps, making it a more refined and controllable successor to the MGC Beta 3x3, without the extra features.
